items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: every night, he and Harry James at the Saratoga Club.

ctx.x: when he got through stealing. He'd steal

I think Benny's OK. ... every night, he and Harry James at the Saratoga Club. Soon as they get through, they wouldn't even change clothes, bring a pencil and paper and sit down and write ... but they can play now.
Sit down and write what, other people's solos?
